fact: On 23 August 2023 the EDPA fined the Sincephetelo Motor Vehicle Fund E150,000 (E100,000 suspended) for publishing national identity numbers of about 1,600 claimants in a newspaper.
title: Decision of the Eswatini Communications Commission in the exercise of its functions as the Eswatini Data Protection Authority on contravention of the Data Protection Act 2022 by Sincephetelo Motor Vehicle Fund (SMVA)
publisher: Eswatini Communications Commission (Eswatini Data Protection Authority)
